english:
My name is Paulose. I come from the Kalparambu Forane Parish, Irinjalakuda Diocese.
I took the covenant on June 14, 2024. What I am saying now is my second testimony.
I handed my house and plot to another person in lease and only received it back after 13 years. That is what I am sharing.
When my close, faithful friend had some legal issues at my house,
to get out of that, I sold my plot and house in lease to another person. Later, it was hidden multiple times.
Someone said I would get it back eventually, under the advice of someone.
When the lease matters were over, these people fled from here,
and I could not catch them even after going a long distance. Then I filed a case against them.
I had given it, and they had issued me a cheque because their house and everything had been sold and they were supposed to receive the money.
At that time, there was a team that prayed a lot, and I believed in that. But after I handed it, they fled.
I submitted their cheque, but it was returned. I filed a case, but nothing came of it. Then I went to the High Court,
and even there, it was returned. When I met the lawyer and explained the details of the case,
the lawyer said that the place given in an illegal lease would never be returned.
Still, I proceeded with the case, which was in 2012. After that, I came here and took the covenant.
When I took the covenant, I received the first testimony. That was a miracle,
because I was confident that the Mother Mary would make it possible.
In the covenant, I stated that I wanted to get my property back. I told the lawyer that this was all prayed for by the Mother.
The lawyer then said that what had been given in an illegal lease would never be returned; moreover,
so much time had passed, and all the cases we filed were dismissed.
There was no evidence at all that they had obtained leasing in their own names, and the cheques were issued under their company’s name,
so the lawyer said that no one could do anything about it. I told the lawyer that great miracles were happening by the Mother of Kreupasanam.
The laws of the country had changed , that had been lost was restored—there were great miracles here.
Not only was this possible by the Mother, but my first testimony itself was a remarkable event.
That is why I had complete faith that the Mother could do it, because something that would never normally happen occurred in my first testimony.
After that, I participated in Holy Mass every day,
performed all family prayers accurately, followed the devotions, did all charitable works, and performed all evangelization faithfully.
I prayed to the Mother constantly, and I alone was confident that I would receive it.
No one else could be sure, because normally it would not be possible.
Since the case had been ongoing for 13 years, there were a huge number of case documents.
The day before the main argument, the lawyer called me to review all the documents and said,
“Let’s discuss this tomorrow, and see how we should present the case.”
So, the lawyer, his assistant, and about five other lawyers went through all the papers,
and after reviewing them, they said, “Let’s just state that the money was not received, and then present the other facts. That’s all we can do.”
On the day of the final argument, I went to court in the morning.
At that time, there was a sweeper present in the court. She had finished her cleaning duties,
and after she finished cleaning the area, I…
I recited the declaration of faith and sprinkled the Mother’s blessed salt everywhere. I continued reciting the declaration of faith
while speaking to the Mother, saying, “Mother, You can accomplish all this, because my first testimony
involved things that would never normally happen in life, yet You made them happen. The Mother brought digital proof of it.”
That is why I had no doubt—it was such a miracle, something impossible. I said, “Mother, this is easy for You,” and continued praying.
Meanwhile, I brought the case documents here and had Father Joseph bless them.
Father Joseph gave me a small blessed medal. Holding that medal in my hand, I proceeded with my declaration of faith,
sprinkling salt and praying as I went. At that time,
it was the moment for our case. Our lawyer came along with his assistant lawyers.
Honestly, there were only two or three minutes’ worth of things to say; there were no further sections to discuss,
because given in lease, no money had been received, the cheque had gone to the High Court,
and some matters had been dismissed.
Most of the issues had already been dismissed, and this is what needed to be presented.
Moreover, the people who had wronged me had separate criminal cheating cases against them, and I had provided copies of those as well,
but the court did not acknowledge any of it. Therefore, there was no hope. We had only two or three minutes to speak.
The lawyer began speaking, and one and a half hours later, the other lawyers present looked at me and asked what is this happening.
The lawyer went through each document one by one, with the assistants handing them to the judge,
explaining each point individually, and the judge was taking notes of everything.
Then the opposing lawyer began to speak. As usual, the opposing lawyer had a few points to present. The opposing lawyer…
In anger, they said that my opponents were not cheaters, but they said nothing further. The case verdict came,
and I got all my property back. I paid the taxes,
and everything was cleared. I received everything I was due.
During the time I was here, with my faith, I came here to the Perpetual rosary and prayed to the Mother.
Normally, I don’t attend Holy Mass regularly because of various needs and obligations.
Sometimes, I can’t go to Sunday Mass. Often, by the time I look at everything, it’s already late—if I lie down at 10 o’clock, that’s the only time I can.
That is why I don’t regularly attend family prayers, because I am not married and live alone.
Then I sleep, and the rest of the routine continues.
I would take newspapers to the church. When giving the newspaper, some people would ask,
“What are you bringing this for?” I would answer, “This is the Mother’s newsetters; "Don't you have shame?". "Is this really trustworthy?”
They will criticize some priests and nuns, making a lot of noise.
But my first testimony, the one I gave first, was a great miracle.
I had grown in faith that the Mother truly lives and appears in person. Everything became clear to me—it was magnificent.
After that, all the disturbances ended.
I had three bundles of newspapers here, which I later consolidated into ten, then twenty, and finally fifty bags—
the amount I could handle. I went to the Thrissur Bus Stand, distributed the newspapers,
went to two more bus stands, and handed out the papers. Now, the Pentecost people came and offered me some papers,
saying that the Mother wanted nothing in return. I replied accordingly.
They would tell me, “Let’s have a discussion; I believe what’s in the Bible.” I would reply, “Take the Bible, let’s talk from it.” Many such issues arose. Some women became very angry and spoke sharply,
but I did not pay attention, because I know what has truly happened in my life. Everything was so clear to me.
I continued those spiritual practices, attending the Akhanda Japa Mala, coming every month, and speaking to the Mother.
I was confident. That is why I won the case and, for the second time, my testimony prevailed.
Then I understood the power of salt. As I said before, wherever I go, I first take the salt and pray.
When I travel by vehicle, I first recite the statement of faith, and then go with the Cross on the vehicle,
feeling very happy and peaceful. I am deeply thankful to Jesus and the Mother.
Since my future life is mostly solitary, I have decided to dedicate it to Jesus and the Mother.
I resolved to pursue spiritual matters with great sincerity and strength.
One benefit of taking this covenant is that my life now has structure and order.
Even someone who did not attend church previously now feels the desire to go.
I no longer feel reluctant to attend Holy Mass. Sometimes I go to Mass at noon, and I have no difficulty in attending.
Earlier, going to Mass felt very boring. I did not even attend family prayers. But now, I do so regularly.
We go to the church for Divine Causes, pray the rosary, and everything is done joyfully and peacefully.
I am deeply thankful to Jesus and the Blessed Mother.
From Chapter 43, Verse 14: “Your Savior and the Holy One of Israel, the Lord, is graciously acting for you. I will send you to Babylon and break all obstacles.”
This is a very powerful testimony of Paulose, standing firmly for Jesus and the Holy Mother.
It is a revelation testimony that he shared with us. Thirteen years had passed since his property had been leased,
and this testimony recounts the great difficulties he faced in getting it back. In that distress, he came here, gave a testimony,
and renewed his prayers and dedication.
What he shares with us is that there is nothing impossible for the Holy Mother.
She can understand and alter all the decrees of Heaven,
and she can even change the laws of any country on Earth. She can alter government regulations.
The Holy Mother is always with us, and therefore, this problem of mine
was never a heavy burden for her. I got my property back.
He shares that taking this covenant in life helped him,
and his experience is meant to be shared for the benefit of others.
Regarding this case, he narrated it to us like an episode:
Something that could have been presented to the lawyer in four or five minutes
he presented carefully for one and a half hours,
ensuring it was delivered in a way that would result in a favorable verdict for him.
In the final episode, he succeeded—and the Holy Mother succeeded.
This is a strong proof of the covenant in his life. We know that when justice is on our side,
as Jesus says, if you seek first your righteousness and your kingdom,
everything else will be added. He has sought Jesus’ kingdom and righteousness.
Once he began seeking, the sluggishness and delays in attending Holy Mass disappeared.
When he entered the kingdom of Jesus, he received a strong inner inspiration: “For my future life, Jesus and the Holy Mother are enough.”
He is now moving forward with many projects, expanding the Kingdom of God.
He tells us that he has both the time and the enthusiasm to achieve as much as he can.
Lastly, regarding him, the Holy Mother says: when the opposing lawyer stood up,
she conveyed that his opponents were not cheaters. This was a great inspiration and motivation given by the Holy Spirit.
This gave him great inspiration and motivation. Let us give thanks to Jesus and the Holy Mother.
Even when everyone abandons us, Jesus will never leave us, because we are under a covenant.
Whenever each person gives a testimony here, what is said is: nothing will happen to me, because I am under covenant.
For the rest of my life, I will be with Jesus eternally.
We can unite all our life’s duties, sufferings, illnesses, solitude, and those living in isolation
with our mission by linking them to this testimony.
By doing this, we give a good offering to Jesus and the Holy Mother and dedicate this testimony to them.
These are extraordinary divine experiences, which can now also be yours.
